title: [CQ-I05] VS Code managed VM interface
description:
Objective: Mirror primary VM lifecycle/readiness/recovery behavior.

Deliverable: VS Code managed VM interface. This is task I05 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd moe-vscode && npm test && npm run compile

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): I04, I03.
definitionOfDone: Unsupported/unready setup cannot enable strict execution.
No profile/evidence fields are discarded in settings roundtrip.
Fresh verification `cd moe-vscode && npm test && npm run compile` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.

Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

It also needs CQ-I04, which is still PLANNING. It auto-returns to PLANNING when I03 and I04 are both DONE. To undo: set_task_status PLANNING.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
- A webview panel like SettingsPanel: rejected. It needs HTML, a media script and a CSP, which is more code and opens an HTML-injection surface. A native TreeView with view/title commands is the VS Code idiom, and it is smaller.
- Calling Multipass or reading a ledger from the extension: rejected, exactly as for I03. The CQ-I03a producer is the only ownership authority.
- Adding profile fields to the typed ProjectSettings: not needed. The client stores the daemon's raw project payload on SETTINGS_UPDATED (MoeDaemonClient about line 988), and SettingsPanel sends only six form keys. DoD 3 is pinned by a roundtrip test instead of a type change.
planningNotes.risks:
- Size: QA rejects past 400 net, and tests count. Use the per-file budget in step 4.
- Plan-size floor: 7 files makes this heavy, so the routing is opus.
- The producer may land different names or codes. Adapt, and keep the fail-closed decoder.
- Node < 22 makes the producer's cleanup preserve everything (DAEMON_UNREACHABLE). Render that as a normal report.
- No VS Code host or VM certification: headless tests only.
- CI wiring of the producer test is owed by I06 (comment on I06).
